reviewStandard: The six queued routes failed the pre-generation molecular-identity, process-scope, analytical, biomarker-qualification, causal, duplication, or statistical-representation gate. They received no marked prompt, no built-in generation call, and no raster. Controlled records, FDA guidance, international consensus, and primary-indexed reviews were checked against the generated article corpus; conflicts and required resolution are preserved in the audit and review packets. Zero hashes are eligible for promotion.
promotionRule: No Batch 082 route is eligible for generation or promotion until its documented identity, scope, representation, evidence, analytical, and causal conflicts are corrected and independently re-audited.

routeDecisions.reason: Mammalian isoforms, species-specific proteins, metalation states, stoichiometries, tissues, and disease claims are compressed into one fixed structure and binding hierarchy.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Select an organism and isoform/accession or PDB structure, exact metalation state, conditions, stoichiometry, and experimentally supported function.

routeDecisions.reason: DNA, histone, protein, and xenobiotic methylation are conflated with one-carbon metabolism and broad microbiome and metal causality.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by process and specify substrate/site, enzyme, donor, organism/tissue, exposure, assay, genomic context, direction, and causal evidence.

routeDecisions.reason: Associations, pathogens, host inflammatory markers, metabolites, and experimental metallophores are presented as clinical tools without analytical or clinical validation.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define BEST category, specimen, measurand, assay, preanalytics, threshold, population, context of use, validation, performance, calibration, and qualification status.

routeDecisions.reason: Host, microbial, co-metabolic, dietary, and hepatic products are combined with categorical beneficial, toxic, and causal disease labels.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Reconcile the duplicate route and organize by compound identifier, source/precursor, organism/enzyme evidence, host co-metabolism, matrix, assay, concentration, and validated effect.

routeDecisions.reason: Estimators and distances with different assumptions are treated as interchangeable disease markers, with generic significance implied without design or model conditions.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Document formulas, assumptions, feature construction, preprocessing, sampling depth, covariates, dispersion, null hypothesis, effect size, uncertainty, and interpretation.

routeDecisions.reason: Microbial attribution, host co-metabolism, concentration, compartment, and causality are blurred across many molecules and diseases.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Merge or distinguish the duplicate route and bound each compound by identity, origin evidence, pathway, compartment, concentration, target, model, and human causal status.
